currency.description: Every price is in US dollars, from the brand's US site.

checked.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern) prices were last checked, or null before the first check.

categories.description: Product categories the page shows statistics for, in display order.

tag.description: Tag id from data/brands.json that groups this category on the page.

description.description: What counts as a product in this category.

observations.description: One entry per product being tracked. Updated in place each check.

product.description: Product name as the brand's site shows it.

url.description: The product page the price came from. Unique across observations.

price.description: What it costs today on the product page, in USD, including any sale price shown. Ignore codes, member-only or checkout-only discounts.

full_price.description: The regular (crossed-out) price, or the same as `price` when it isn't discounted.

date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD, US Eastern) this price was last seen.
